discovery_questions: Which intended domain outcomes remain incomplete
What independent evidence establishes useful completion
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative completed domain outcomes under a fixed evidence standard
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze representative work and difficult negative cases
Declare whether fixtures are disclosed or sealed
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound the implementation surface without narrowing the judged workload
invalid_proxy_warnings: Activity counts are not completed outcomes
stop_policy_defaults: Stop on any hard constraint failure
Stop when the finite candidate budget is exhausted

discovery_questions: Which declared environments or contracts are unsupported
What unsafe compatibility must remain refused
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative supported contract coverage under unchanged semantics
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze declared environment rows and incompatibility cases
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound adapters and portability surfaces while preserving canonical vocabulary
invalid_proxy_warnings: Process startup is not semantic compatibility

discovery_questions: Which externally meaningful results are wrong or underspecified
What oracle can distinguish stronger correctness
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative oracle accepted results across representative inputs
fixture_holdout_guidance: Bind oracle identity separately from candidate code
candidate_scope_guidance: Allow correctness changes only inside the declared behavior surface
invalid_proxy_warnings: Self reported success is not an oracle

discovery_questions: Which change cost is caused by duplicated or entangled decisions
Which behavior and refusal contracts must remain equivalent
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative change cost reduction under behavioral equivalence
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze representative changes and public behavior
Retain negative paths as first class fixtures
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound one change surface and forbid moving complexity outside it
invalid_proxy_warnings: Line count alone is not maintainability
Module count is not change cost
stop_policy_defaults: Stop on test or evidence weakening

discovery_questions: Where do operators spend avoidable interaction or recovery effort
What terminal evidence must remain unchanged
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative interaction or recovery reduction for equivalent outcomes
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze representative operator journeys and refusal recovery
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound workflow presentation without weakening domain checks
invalid_proxy_warnings: Fewer interactions without outcome equivalence are not improvement

discovery_questions: Which resource limits block useful work
What workload and quality must remain fixed
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative resource reduction or throughput increase on frozen work
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze workload identity and warmup policy
Declare sampling population and measurement noise
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound optimization surfaces and account for displaced cost
invalid_proxy_warnings: Microbenchmark speed is not end outcome throughput
Smaller artifacts are not automatically more efficient
stop_policy_defaults: Stop when measurement noise exceeds the declared bound

discovery_questions: Which faults cause unsafe success or unrecoverable work
What exact recovery proves restored operation
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative correct fault diagnosis and recovery completion
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze fault classes and valid states
Separate disclosed local cases from genuinely sealed cases
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound detection and recovery surfaces while preserving fail closed behavior
invalid_proxy_warnings: Shorter error text is not recovery
Successful process exit is not restored authority
stop_policy_defaults: Stop on infrastructure failure before scoring

discovery_questions: Which authority crossing can accept unauthenticated or overbroad state
What independent boundary evidence is available
admissible_primary_outcomes: Quantitative safe operation coverage under preserved authority checks
fixture_holdout_guidance: Freeze adversarial and legitimate boundary cases
candidate_scope_guidance: Bound one authority boundary and exclude self authorization
invalid_proxy_warnings: Local process isolation is not adversarial containment
